mapper.select: select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, c1.C_Name as vpCName, c1.C_Abbreviation as vpCAbbName, sec.Sec_Name as secName, sd.D_Name as vpDName, qst.Qst_Score as qstScore, qst.Qst_Punish as qstPunish, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Qs_Violation_Punishment mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id left join SYS_Department sd on sd.D_ID=mn.Vp_D_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.Vp_C_Id left join Qs_Type qst on qst.Qst_Id=mn.Qst_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Vp_Id where mn.Vp_Id=#{vpId}
